high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "symbolicmagic." The post features two illustrations of animals with chakras labeled on them. Top Illustration (Cat): The top illustration shows a cat with seven colored dots representing different chakras. The chakras are labeled as follows: Crown (white dot) Third Eye (purple dot) Throat (blue dot) Heart (green dot) Solar Plexus (yellow dot) Belly (orange dot) Root (red dot)
